items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 agent teams found quantum algorithms up to 290x cheaper for fusion, chemistry and drug-design problems. Every result was proved correct in Lean, with an external checker re-running the proofs.
items.title: Gemini 4 agent teams cut quantum costs up to 290x

items.excerpt: Cactus Compute released Mirage on November 6, 2026, a 51.3-million-parameter vision model that fits in about 22 MB. It handles description, detection, OCR and segmentation in a single pass, returning structured JSON instead of chat.
items.title: Mirage packs vision, OCR and masks into 22 MB

items.excerpt: It follows Claude Ship, which pushed Claude into pull-request approval. SiliconANGLE calls it one of Anthropic's more consequential recent updates, with potential to displace traditional desktop app development.
items.title: Claude now builds full desktop apps from one prompt

items.excerpt: As of November 24, 2026, xAI still has no Grok 4.8 model ID or price published, and its docs still list Grok 4.7 as the newest model. Musk said on November 19 that several variants are in beta and xAI has not decided which one will go to wide release.
items.title: Grok 4.8 still isn't out

items.excerpt: Ocean Network 的 ON 补贴今天上线，给出 $7.30 一次性免费额度。补贴只适用于带 Subsidized 标记的服务，选错节点按原价计费。
items.title: Ocean 补贴送免费 H200 算力
